title: Passive, Relative, Conjunction — Level 6 — Read the notice, text, and table

tags.kisi-kisi: Passive Voice, Relative Pronoun, and Conjunction

items.prompt: Read the pool notice. Why can't students use the swimming pool today?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is being cleaned today. It will be reopened on Thursday. All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon. (Sports Office, SMPN 2 Batu)

visual.text: It is closed for a race.

choices.say: It is closed for a race.

items.prompt: Read the pool notice. What must students do by Wednesday afternoon?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is being cleaned today. It will be reopened on Thursday. All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon. (Sports Office, SMPN 2 Batu)

items.reteach: "All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon."

items.prompt: Read the pool notice. Who wrote it?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is being cleaned today. It will be reopened on Thursday. All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon. (Sports Office, SMPN 2 Batu)

items.reteach: Penulis notice ada di bagian akhir: Sports Office.

items.prompt: Read the text about the craftsman. Whose masks are sold in Malang?

stimulus.text: Pak Sanusi is a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang. The workshop where he works is next to his house. Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve.

items.reteach: "a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang" = topeng milik Pak Sanusi.

items.prompt: Read the text about the craftsman. In the text, "where" refers to …

stimulus.text: Pak Sanusi is a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang. The workshop where he works is next to his house. Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve.

items.reteach: "The workshop where he works" — where merujuk ke workshop.

items.prompt: Read the text about the craftsman. Who can watch Pak Sanusi carve?

stimulus.text: Pak Sanusi is a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang. The workshop where he works is next to his house. Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve.

items.reteach: "Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve."

items.prompt: Read the table of school events. Which statement about the art show is true?

visual.text: The art show was held on 12 May.

choices.say: The art show was held on 12 May.

visual.text: The art show was postponed to June.

choices.say: The art show was postponed to June.

visual.text: The art show will be held on 5 May.

choices.say: The art show will be held on 5 May.

items.prompt: Read the table of school events. Which sentence about the book week is correct?

visual.text: The book week has been postponed to June.

choices.say: The book week has been postponed to June.

visual.text: The book week was held on 20 May.

choices.say: The book week was held on 20 May.

visual.text: The book week has been cancelled.

choices.say: The book week has been cancelled.

visual.text: The book week was held on 5 May.

choices.say: The book week was held on 5 May.

items.reteach: Status book week = postponed to June (ditunda).

items.prompt: Read the table of school events. Which event was held as planned in May?
Read the text about Ijen. Why do most hikers start at about 1 a.m.?

stimulus.text: Ijen is famous for its blue fire. However, the fire can only be seen in the dark before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m., although the path is steep and cold.

visual.text: because the blue fire can only be seen before dawn

choices.say: because the blue fire can only be seen before dawn

visual.text: because it is warm at night

choices.say: because it is warm at night

visual.text: because the crater closes at noon

choices.say: because the crater closes at noon

items.reteach: "However, the fire can only be seen … before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m."

items.prompt: Read the text about Ijen. Which linking word in the text introduces a result?

stimulus.text: Ijen is famous for its blue fire. However, the fire can only be seen in the dark before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m., although the path is steep and cold.

items.prompt: Read the text about Ijen. What does "although the path is steep and cold" tell us?

stimulus.text: Ijen is famous for its blue fire. However, the fire can only be seen in the dark before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m., although the path is steep and cold.

visual.text: Hikers still go even though the path is difficult.

choices.say: Hikers still go even though the path is difficult.

visual.text: Hikers stay home because of the path.

choices.say: Hikers stay home because of the path.

visual.text: The path is easy and warm.

choices.say: The path is easy and warm.

visual.text: The blue fire is on the path.

choices.say: The blue fire is on the path.

items.reteach: although = meskipun: tetap mendaki walau jalannya sulit.
